_notes: Fleet config (ADR-0034): one concept, the JOB. Hot-reloaded every 60s; history in docs/worklogs.
accounts: three classes (ADR-0034, "Account classes"). An account belongs to exactly one.
accounts.pool: accounts the pool and the policy may use, in preference order. FREE models only. Never PROBE, never SMOKE*.
accounts.paid: the paid class (ADR-0034 amendment 2026-08-23). A paid pick lands only here, never in the pool;
with policy.paid present and this list empty, paid picks are HELD ("no paid account configured"), not spilled.
Coexistence: listing an account says who may SCHEDULE it, `enabled` says who HOLDS it — only an enabled job holds.
So a DISABLED pinned job may park on a listed account (SHAKEOUT2 below); an enabled one may not.
The split governs the POLICY: a manual queue job with no account draws from the pool whatever its billing.
accounts.local: the local class. A model whose apiBase is on the LAN or loopback (isLocalBase, runner/src/model-cost.ts)
lands only here — the LM Studio box serves one runner at a time, so its account IS the limit. Unlike paid there is no
policy block to switch it on: the split is always live, and a local model with no accounts.local is HELD
("no local account configured"), never spilled into the pool. Free and paid picks never take a local account.
roster: name -> roster entry (exact run-roster schema; may carry objective/watchdogs/maxToolCalls/wikiCoords).
Optional: tiers (manual FORCE, normally absent), runsPerEpisode { e90, e360 } (per-entry target).
policy: runsPerEpisode targets (default 3/3); maxConcurrent { <driver>: n } caps streams per driver.
Optional (ADR-0034 amendment 2026-08-23; absent = off): paid { runsPerEpisode {e90 3, e360 1}, maxConcurrent 1 } gives paid models
hard targets and one-in-flight; extras { characters [{race,class}...] } gives free models extra runs when the pool is idle.
extras.local says how the LOCAL class takes its extras: "freeplay" (default) is one unbounded freeplay run at a time, restarted
when it ends — the box is inference-bound, so speed comparisons are meaningless but a model that keeps playing is long-horizon
data; "characters" puts it on the same race/class cycle the free models run. Either way an extra never counts toward e90/e360.
Billing is derived (free slug / LAN / claude-code / allowlist -> free; else paid); roster.<name>.billing overrides.
Counting keys on the harness SERIES (major.minor) of the running checkout; other series are shown, not counted.
queue: jobs { ref | [refs], episode e90|e360|freeplay, repeat n|"loop", enabled, account? }.
account set = PINNED to it (never policy-scheduled); absent = manual pool job, outranks the policy.
Name is <first ref>-<episode>; one job per (ref, episode). A job with no account and nothing eligible is skipped.
Roster policy: claude models only via driver claude-code; shared free pools carry free ids only; local apiBase exempt.
preflight: ADR-0023; its accounts may not be in the pool or on a job.

nav-probe.objective: Travel from Coldridge Valley to Ironforge, then take the Deeprun Tram from Ironforge to Stormwind. Use roads and the game's own transport (the tram; flight masters once discovered). Keep a travel log in the scratchpad: destination chosen, route chosen, what worked, what failed and why. In each city, find the flight master and a trainer and note them in the log. Once in Stormwind, keep exploring and questing there.
